findings.summary: Static futures catalog contains 32 roots; only NQ, MNQ, ES, MES, YM, MYM, RTY, M2K, GC, MGC, SI and SIL qualify for the execution resolver. Resolver qualification is distinct from fresh market data, risk/journal readiness, broker contract/account readback and order authority. Live execution remains disabled.

All 200 catalogued US equities have pulse_enabled=false and entitlement=UNKNOWN. Catalog visibility and research browsing do not establish tradability, corporate-action correctness, fresh feed rights or profitability. No account/provider read was performed.

Eight researched firms contain 46 account types and 49 policies, all policies UNVERIFIED. Every firm has connection_verified=false, free_account_or_api_verified=false, faq_coverage_complete=false, new_intents_blocked=true and execution_authorized=false. Free local inventory does not establish free remote accounts or APIs. Topstep configuration remains LATER.

Connection snapshots expire CONNECTED_READ_ONLY observations after 60 seconds and force policy_status=UNVERIFIED, blocked new intents and false execution authority. Manual inventory is local-only. Alpaca and ProjectX are coded/mock-tested read-only adapters; Rithmic, Tradovate and IBKR are unsupported in this manager. Source inspection is not proof of a live account connection.

Canonical paper P&L validator requires four unique explicit-currency runtime ledgers and snapshots/open marks no older than 90 seconds. Unknown marks suppress open/total while preserving independently valid realized P&L; missing runtime suppresses combined realized too. At this main snapshot, paper_workspaces.py still exposes unchecked raw aggregate/profile sums beside canonical paper_pnl. Icarus 1 already reserves this exact defect boundary and its server projection/tests; do not duplicate or overwrite that repair. Fees, broker reconciliation and owner-PC restart/runtime identity remain unverified.
